name: Temporary market shock pricing and expiry

tests.name: Choose a port commodity for quote verification

data.sql: SELECT port_id, commodity FROM port_trade ORDER BY port_id, commodity LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Enable deterministic scheduler advancement in this disposable database

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

INSERT INTO market_shocks (trigger_source, player_id, scope_type, port_id, commodity_code, multiplier_bps, starts_at, expires_at, idempotency_key) VALUES ('player', @{admin_player_id}, 'port', @{shock_port_id}, '@{shock_commodity}', 40000, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '10 seconds', 'v2-market-shock-e2e');

tests.name: Verify scoped multiplier changes quoted prices
Verify the shock scope and duration are stored

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN scope_type = 'port' AND port_id = @{shock_port_id} AND commodity_code = '@{shock_commodity}' AND multiplier_bps = 40000 AND expires_at - starts_at = INTERVAL '10 seconds' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM market_shocks WHERE idempotency_key = 'v2-market-shock-e2e';

tests.name: Choose deterministic time after shock expiry
Save cron schedule and make only shock cleanup due

data.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS qa_market_shock_cron_restore AS SELECT name,enabled,last_run_at,next_due_at FROM cron_tasks WHERE FALSE;
INSERT INTO qa_market_shock_cron_restore SELECT name,enabled,last_run_at,next_due_at FROM cron_tasks;

tests.name: Enable only the market shock handler and defer its wall-clock run

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='market_shock_tick'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='market_shock_tick' THEN to_timestamp(@{market_shock_tick_at}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Execute registered shock cleanup at deterministic expiry time
Verify the expired shock was removed

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_shocks WHERE idempotency_key = 'v2-market-shock-e2e';

tests.name: Verify quotes return to baseline after expiry
Restore cron scheduler state after isolated acceptance

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks c SET enabled=r.enabled,last_run_at=r.last_run_at,next_due_at=r.next_due_at FROM qa_market_shock_cron_restore r WHERE c.name=r.name;
